description: This file contains a utility function `shapeAgentGroupedSeries` that processes an array of cost records to produce a dataset suitable for visualization with Recharts. It groups data by agents and categories (like environment or cost_category), applies sorting options, and fills in missing categories with zero values for consistency across groups.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost records into a structured, grouped dataset for visualization, ensuring all agent-category combinations are represented, with optional sorting and categorization options.
